key_highlights: ASX slides as rising oil prices fuel RBA rate hike bets; big four banks (CBA, ANZ, NAB, WBC) fall on margin compression fears
Iron ore in freefall – BHP under existential pressure as commodity 'drowns'; FMG and RIO exposed
RBA deputy governor signals inflation still too high, reinforcing hawkish bias and bond yield pressure
Hormuz Strait escalation and Houthi strikes on Saudi oil facilities spike crude, complicating RBA path
Australian property sector faces 'GFC moment' as home buyer sentiment collapses; REITs under pressure
Gold miners (Forrestania, Kaiser, Manhattan, Aureka) deliver strong results amid safe-haven demand
Santos gas cartel dynamics shift, reshaping energy sector competitive landscape
Qantas (QAN.AX) issues $35M payout to fired workers, weighing on near-term earnings
Australia records worst-ever global maths and reading scores, signalling long-term productivity drag
Living standards collapse masked by public sector boom; households forced into second jobs

sectors.trend: Severely negative. Iron ore in structural decline; BHP facing existential question. Gold miners bucking trend with strong production and safe-haven bid.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face significant downside. Gold names (FOR.AX, KCG, MNG.AX, AUK.AX, LRV.AX) offer relative strength. Diversify away from iron ore exposure.

sectors.trend: Negative. Big four banks fall as rate hike bets compress net interest margins and raise credit risk. Bond yield volatility adds uncertainty.
sectors.implications: CBA.AX, ANZ.AX, NAB.AX, WBC.AX under pressure. RBA hawkishness (deputy governor) limits rate-cut timeline, squeezing margin expansion. Watch for credit cycle deterioration.

sectors.trend: Mixed-to-positive. Oil spikes on Hormuz/Houthi risk. Santos gas cartel dynamics shift, creating both risk and opportunity in LNG.
sectors.implications: SOL.AX faces competitive disruption. Woodside (WDS.AX) and oil-exposed names benefit from crude spike. Geopolitical premium supports energy valuations short-term.

sectors.trend: Sharply negative. 'GFC moment' narrative, collapsing buyer sentiment, and construction capacity crisis create multi-year headwind.
sectors.implications: REITs (GPW.AX, ICPS.AX, DGL.AX) face occupancy and cap-rate pressure. Construction names (WBC-linked, WES.AX) hit by demand collapse. Avoid property-linked equities.

sectors.trend: Negative for discretionary; defensive for staples. Households squeezed by mortgage costs; Qantas payout signals labour cost stress.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, WOL.AX face demand softness. CSL.AX, SGH.AX offer defensive quality. QAN.AX hit by $35M payout. Tobacco tax debate (BAT, JG.AX) adds policy risk.

sectors.trend: Neutral. ATO vs Big Tech tax fight creates regulatory overhang. Limited direct ASX impact but signals broader tax policy direction.
sectors.implications: ASX tech names (W1.AX, XRO.AX) face potential tax policy shifts. ATO enforcement may broaden to Australian digital platforms.

key_themes: RBA hawkish pivot: inflation persistence forces rate-hike repricing, pressuring banks and property
Iron ore structural decline: BHP and peers face margin compression; pivot to gold and critical minerals
Geopolitical oil premium: Hormuz and Houthi risks sustain crude above trend, complicating disinflation
Property GFC narrative: sentiment collapse and construction capacity crisis threaten multi-year demand
Living standards squeeze: second jobs, mortgage stress, and public-sector-dependent growth mask private-sector weakness
Gold as macro hedge: multiple ASX-listed miners deliver production upside amid safe-haven demand

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA rate hike / prolonged tight policy
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce leverage; favour short-duration bonds and dividend-paying defensives (CSL.AX, WES.AX)
Underweight BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (FOR.AX, MNG.AX) and critical minerals
Hedge with energy exposure (WDS.AX, SOL.AX); monitor AUD/USD as oil spike pressures terms of trade
Avoid property-linked equities and REITs; monitor NAB.AX, ANZ.AX loan-loss provisions
Favour staples (WES.AX, WOL.AX) over discretionary; watch retail sales data
Monitor SOL.AX competitive positioning; favour WDS.AX as more diversified energy play

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight ASX gold miners on safe-haven bid and production upside
opportunities.rationale: Multiple miners (Forrestania, Kaiser, Manhattan, Aureka) hitting production milestones; gold supported by geopolitical risk and rate uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Tactical energy hedge via Woodside on oil spike
opportunities.rationale: Hormuz/Houthi risk sustains crude premium; WDS.AX less exposed to gas cartel disruption than SOL.AX

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt to CSL and Wesfarmers
opportunities.rationale: Healthcare and staples provide earnings visibility amid rate and property headwinds

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce or exit iron ore exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore in structural decline; BHP facing existential question; margin compression likely through 2027
GFC narrative, collapsing buyer sentiment, and construction capacity crisis create multi-year headwind

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim bank exposure pending RBA path clarity
defensive_moves.rationale: Rate hike bets compress NIMs; credit cycle risk rising with property stress

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to extend slide on rate-hike repricing, iron ore weakness, and property stress. Banks and materials lead declines. Gold and energy provide relative outperformance. AUD under pressure from oil-driven terms-of-trade volatility.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautious. Structural iron ore decline and property cycle reset weigh on ASX 200. Gold, healthcare, and critical minerals offer rotation targets. RBA policy normalisation and living standards recovery are 12-month catalysts. Productivity concerns (worst global test scores) cap long-term growth.

Australian property data: buyer sentiment, dwelling approvals, REIT occupancies
Santos gas cartel resolution and LNG pricing
ATO tax enforcement actions on Big Tech / digital platforms

RBA cash rate and 3/10-year bond yields
Brent crude and LNG spot prices
Gold spot (XAU/USD) and ASX gold miner index
CPI, retail sales, and dwelling approvals data releases
